authorizedScope: Exact source/evidence-only Genie dev publication; full wish remains IN_PROGRESS
scopeAlgorithm: Exact authored changed/untracked paths already reviewed, plus16 explicit ignored generated outputs and named publication-only evidence. Git regular modes normalize nonexecutable to100644 and executable to100755; all actual file bytes are checked.
deltaExplanation: Only append current actual gates/reviews/limitations to existing WISH ReviewResults; no source/config/lock/generated/API changes. New evidence-only artifacts were explicitly excluded by review manifest enumeration time.
nonTargetIndexAuthority: Main captures exact mode/object/stage map and will compare after commit; original index byte SHA alone not claimed unchanged when owned entries are correctly advanced to new HEAD
